baseline: Without the skill, Claude asks for every value in one long list or guesses them, writes loop.config.json in a shape the runner does not expect (or edits loop/lib/config.mjs to make the check pass), pastes secrets such as the DB URL into .env.example, pushes a new develop branch without asking, and declares the setup done without running the validator or the dry run. LOOP-0 is never run, so a broken pipeline shows up only in the first real item.

scenarios.query: /setup-loop — I just clicked 'Use this template' and cloned it. The repo is acme/recipe-box. Make the loop runnable.
files: a git remote with only main
expected_behavior: Runs check-config.mjs first and uses its PROBLEM lines as the to-do list
Copies the setup checklist into the reply and ticks steps off
Asks exactly one question per message, each with a recommended answer and a reason
Recommends develop as base and main as production, and reads ciCheck from the CI workflow instead of asking
Asks before running git push to create develop on origin, showing the exact commands
Writes DEV_DB_URL= and VERCEL_BYPASS= with empty values into .env.example and never asks for the secret values in chat
Reruns check-config.mjs after writing until it prints ready or only owner actions remain
Runs node loop/run.mjs --dry-run and confirms LOOP-0 is the next item
Offers, but does not start without a yes, node loop/run.mjs --once --item LOOP-0

scenarios.query: /setup-loop — we moved the dev database to a new Supabase project and the preview URL changed. Everything else is the same.
expected_behavior: Reads the existing config and shows the values already set instead of asking for them again
Asks only for the new allowedDbProject and the new devUrl, one at a time
Recommends adding the old project ref to guard.forbiddenRefs
Leaves repo, branches, gitAuthor, budgets and review values unchanged
Checks the new devUrl answers on the health path before writing it
Reruns check-config.mjs and the dry run and quotes their result

files: a machine where claude --version is below the floor and gh auth status fails
expected_behavior: Reports the Claude Code version against the floor printed by check-config.mjs, without writing a version number into any file
Tells the user to run claude update and ! gh auth login themselves instead of running interactive logins
Does not edit loop/lib/config.mjs to lower the floor
Continues with the config questions that do not depend on the tools, then reruns the validator once the user reports the fix
